_about: Answers for an unattended run: install.py --answers answers.json --home <test folder>. Every question the installer may ask has a key here; a missing key stops the installer before anything is written. With --answers the installer refuses to run against your real home folder. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored.
_continue_without_claude: Step 2. Asked only when neither ~/.claude nor the claude command is found. false stops the installer.
_continue_without_obsidian: Step 2. Asked only when Obsidian is not found. false stops the installer.
_python_command: Step 3. The command that runs Python 3.10+; it fills {{PY}} in hooks, tasks and notes. Windows: py -3, macOS/Linux: python3.
_install_vault: Step 4. false skips the vault and every later step (they need a vault).
_vault_path: Step 4. Folder of the vault. Absolute, or relative to --home. A folder with other files in it is refused.
_reuse_vault: Step 4. Asked only when vault_path already holds a Mindgate vault in the same language (second install). true uses it without copying anything into it.
_global_instructions: Step 5. When ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md exists: import (core in ~/.claude/mindgate/CLAUDE.md + one marked import line) | merge (core between marked lines at the end of your file) | skip. When it does not exist: write | skip (import and merge count as write).
_hooks: Step 6. all | none | pick. Hooks that are already installed are never added again.
_hooks_pick: Step 6. Used only with hooks = pick: the hook ids to add.
_name_conflict: Step 7. When a skill or agent with the same name exists (and differs): skip | rename (installed as mindgate-<name>). Never overwritten.
_daily_task: Step 8. Write the daily task to ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/.
_scan_all_projects: Step 8. Asked when a task is installed. false = only sessions that ran in the vault (config.json daily.scan_all_projects).
_git_push: Step 8. Asked when a task is installed. false = commit only, no push (config.json daily.git_push).
_weekly_trending: Step 8. Asked only when the weekly task is installed. true = the last step of the weekly task reads one web page (https://github.com/trending?since=weekly), still only after the site guard asks you; false = the step is skipped (config.json weekly.trending).
_optional_rules: Step 9. Numbers of the optional rules to turn on (rules/general-rules.md, 'Optional rules'): 9 usage limit, 17 only this computer (saves a fingerprint of the computer name). Rule 29 needs the dashboard, which is not part of v1.
_usage_limit_5h: Step 9. Asked only with rule 9: percent of the 5-hour allowance.
_usage_limit_week: Step 9. Asked only with rule 9: percent of the weekly allowance.
_confirm: Step 10. Write everything in the summary. false writes nothing. The uninstaller uses this key too.
